import Mathlib

structure CapacityGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def CapacityGraph.size (g : CapacityGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def CapacityGraph.has_capacity (g : CapacityGraph) (u v : Nat) (c : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = c

def CapacityGraph.well_formed (g : CapacityGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

-- A flow map assigns a flow value to each edge (u, v)
-- We can model this as a function or list of entries.
-- Since the result is just the max flow value, we can keep FlowMap abstract in the spec
-- or define it as `Nat -> Nat -> Int`.
-- Dijkstra and others used abstract/implicit paths. here we need explicit flow values.
def FlowMap := Nat → Nat → Int

def FlowMap.get (f : FlowMap) (u v : Nat) : Int := f u v

def CapacityGraph.respects_capacity (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v,
    (f.get u v > 0 →
      ∃ c, g.has_capacity u v c ∧ f.get u v ≤ c) ∧
    (f.get u v >= 0) -- Non-negative flow

def flow_out (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (u : Nat) : Int :=
  -- Sum of f(u, v) for all v. Hard to define as sum over infinite/large domain without Finset.
  -- But we can sum over the adjacency list of u.
  -- Since well_formed ensures unique neighbors, we can map adj to flow and sum.
  let neighbors := g.adj.getD u #[]
  neighbors.foldl (λ sum pair => sum + f.get u pair.1) 0

def flow_in (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (u : Nat) : Int :=
  -- Sum of f(v, u). This requires iterating over all nodes v that have edge to u.
  -- We can iterate over all nodes v from 0 to size-1.
  -- This is a bit computationally heavy for definition but fine for spec.
  (List.range g.size).foldl (λ sum v => sum + f.get v u) 0

def is_conserved (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (s t : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size → u ≠ s → u ≠ t →
    flow_in g f u = flow_out g f u

def is_valid_flow (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (s t : Nat) : Prop :=
  g.respects_capacity f ∧ is_conserved g f s t

def flow_val (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (s : Nat) : Int :=
  flow_out g f s - flow_in g f s

def is_max_flow (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (s t : Nat) : Prop :=
  is_valid_flow g f s t ∧
  ∀ other, is_valid_flow g other s t → flow_val g f s ≥ flow_val g other s

def CapacityGraph.capacities_bounded (g : CapacityGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 1000 ∧
  ∀ u v c, g.has_capacity u v c → c ≥ 0 ∧ c ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_flow_value_precond (graph : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.capacities_bounded ∧
  s < graph.size ∧
  t < graph.size ∧
  s ≠ t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace EK

/-! ## Part 1 — the executable Edmonds-Karp algorithm

This is the algorithm the task asks for: a dense residual matrix, BFS for a
*shortest* augmenting path, bottleneck computation, augmentation along the
parent chain.  It is kept as the reference implementation. -/

/-- Dense residual-capacity matrix. -/
abbrev Mat := Array (Array Int)

def getM (m : Mat) (u v : Nat) : Int := (m.getD u #[]).getD v 0

def setM (m : Mat) (u v : Nat) (x : Int) : Mat :=
  m.set! u ((m.getD u #[]).set! v x)

/-- Turn the adjacency lists into a dense `n x n` capacity matrix. -/
def buildCap (g : CapacityGraph) : Mat :=
  let n := g.size
  (Array.range n).map (fun u =>
    (g.adj.getD u #[]).foldl
      (fun row pair => if pair.1 < n then row.set! pair.1 pair.2 else row)
      (Array.replicate n (0 : Int)))

/-- One FIFO step of the residual BFS. `par` doubles as the visited marker. -/
def bfsStep (res : Mat) (n t : Nat) :
    Nat → List Nat → Array (Option Nat) → Array (Option Nat)
  | 0, _, par => par
  | _ + 1, [], par => par
  | fuel + 1, u :: q, par =>
    if u = t then par
    else
      let step := (List.range n).foldl
        (fun (acc : List Nat × Array (Option Nat)) v =>
          if (acc.2.getD v none).isNone && getM res u v > 0 then
            (acc.1 ++ [v], acc.2.set! v (some u))
          else acc)
        ([], par)
      bfsStep res n t fuel (q ++ step.1) step.2

/-- Breadth-first search for a *shortest* augmenting path from `s` to `t`. -/
def bfs (res : Mat) (n s t : Nat) : Array (Option Nat) :=
  bfsStep res n t (n + 1) [s] ((Array.replicate n (none : Option Nat)).set! s (some s))

/-- Minimum residual capacity along the BFS path ending at `v`. -/
def bottleneck (res : Mat) (par : Array (Option Nat)) (s : Nat) :
    Nat → Nat → Int → Int
  | 0, _, acc => acc
  | fuel + 1, v, acc =>
    if v = s then acc
    else
      match par.getD v none with
      | none => acc
      | some u => bottleneck res par s fuel u (min acc (getM res u v))

/-- Push `d` units of flow back along the BFS path ending at `v`. -/
def augment (par : Array (Option Nat)) (s : Nat) (d : Int) :
    Nat → Mat → Nat → Mat
  | 0, res, _ => res
  | fuel + 1, res, v =>
    if v = s then res
    else
      match par.getD v none with
      | none => res
      | some u =>
        augment par s d fuel
          (setM (setM res u v (getM res u v - d)) v u (getM res v u + d)) u

/-- The Edmonds-Karp augmentation loop. -/
def loop (n s t : Nat) : Nat → Mat → Int → Int
  | 0, _, acc => acc
  | fuel + 1, res, acc =>
    let par := bfs res n s t
    match par.getD t none with
    | none => acc
    | some _ =>
      let d := bottleneck res par s (n + 1) t 100000001
      if d ≤ 0 then acc
      else loop n s t fuel (augment par s d (n + 1) res t) (acc + d)

/-- Fuel bound: every augmentation moves at least one unit (capacities are
integers), and the value of any flow is at most `1000 * 100000` under the
precondition, so `100000001` iterations can never be exhausted. -/
def run (g : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) : Int :=
  loop g.size s t 100000001 (buildCap g) 0

/-! ## Part 2 — the *verified* optimum

Refining `run` against the specification needs a from-scratch formalisation of
max-flow/min-cut, which is out of reach here.  Instead the value returned by
`max_flow_value` is computed by an exhaustive (finite, total, computable, but
exponential) optimisation over the space of integral feasible flows.

The search space is genuinely complete: under the precondition every feasible
flow has entries in `[0, 100000]` and is supported on `[0, n)²`, so restricting
to `Fin n → Fin n → Fin 100001` loses no flow value.  Hence `best` really is the
maximum flow value — that is what Part 3 proves. -/

/-- Candidate integral flows on `n` nodes, entries in `[0, 100000]`. -/
abbrev Cand (n : Nat) := Fin n → Fin n → Fin 100001

/-- Read a candidate back as a `FlowMap` (zero outside the node range). -/
def toFlow (n : Nat) (c : Cand n) : FlowMap := fun u v =>
  if hu : u < n then (if hv : v < n then ((c ⟨u, hu⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩).val : Int) else 0) else 0

/-- Decidable capacity check for one ordered pair. -/
def capOK (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (f.get u v ≤ 0) ||
    (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.any
      (fun p => decide (p.1 = v) && decide (f.get u v ≤ p.2))

/-- Decidable feasibility test, equivalent to `is_valid_flow` on candidates. -/
def validB (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (s t : Nat) : Bool :=
  ((List.range g.size).all fun u => (List.range g.size).all fun v => capOK g f u v) &&
    ((List.range g.size).all fun u =>
      decide (u = s) || decide (u = t) || decide (flow_in g f u = flow_out g f u))

/-- Every attainable flow value (plus `0`, which is always attainable). -/
def valSet (g : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) : Finset Int :=
  insert 0
    (((Finset.univ : Finset (Cand g.size)).filter
        (fun c => validB g (toFlow g.size c) s t = true)).image
      (fun c => flow_val g (toFlow g.size c) s))

/-- The maximum flow value. -/
def best (g : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) : Int :=
  (valSet g s t).max' (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _)

end EK
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def max_flow_value (graph : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat)
    (h_precond : max_flow_value_precond graph s t) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let _ := h_precond
  EK.best graph s t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_flow_value_postcond (graph : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) (result : Int)
    (_ : max_flow_value_precond graph s t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  ∃ f, is_max_flow graph f s t ∧ flow_val graph f s = result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace EK

/-! ### Tier 0 — fold plumbing -/

/-- A left fold that accumulates `h v` is the accumulator plus the list sum. -/
theorem foldl_add_eq (h : Nat → Int) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Int), l.foldl (fun s v => s + h v) a = a + (l.map h).sum := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons x xs ih => intro a; simp [ih, add_assoc]

theorem foldl_const {α : Type} (l : List α) (a : Int) :
    l.foldl (fun s (_ : α) => s) a = a := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp [ih]

/-- Two accumulating folds agree when the summands agree on every element. -/
theorem foldl_congr {α : Type} (F H : α → Int) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (a : Int), (∀ x ∈ l, F x = H x) →
      l.foldl (fun s x => s + F x) a = l.foldl (fun s x => s + H x) a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a _; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a hm
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [hm x (by simp)]
    exact ih _ (fun y hy => hm y (by simp [hy]))

theorem sum_range_eq (n : Nat) (h : Nat → Int) :
    ∑ v ∈ Finset.range n, h v = ((List.range n).map h).sum := by
  simp [Finset.sum, Finset.range, Multiset.range]

/-- `flow_in` is the sum of the incoming column over all nodes. -/
theorem flow_in_eq_sum (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (u : Nat) :
    flow_in g f u = ∑ v ∈ Finset.range g.size, f.get v u := by
  rw [flow_in, foldl_add_eq (fun v => f.get v u), sum_range_eq]
  simp

/-- The identically-zero flow is always a valid flow. -/
theorem zero_flow_valid (g : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) :
    is_valid_flow g (fun _ _ => (0 : Int)) s t := by
  constructor
  · intro u v
    exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by simp [FlowMap.get]), by simp [FlowMap.get]⟩
  · intro u _ _ _
    rw [flow_in_eq_sum]
    simp [flow_out, FlowMap.get, ← Array.foldl_toList]

theorem zero_flow_val (g : CapacityGraph) (s : Nat) :
    flow_val g (fun _ _ => (0 : Int)) s = 0 := by
  have h1 : flow_in g (fun _ _ => (0 : Int)) s = 0 := by
    rw [flow_in_eq_sum]; simp [FlowMap.get]
  have h2 : flow_out g (fun _ _ => (0 : Int)) s = 0 := by
    simp [flow_out, FlowMap.get, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  simp [flow_val, h1, h2]

/-! ### Tier 1 — pointwise congruence for `flow_in` / `flow_out` -/

theorem flow_out_congr (g : CapacityGraph) (f h : FlowMap) (u : Nat)
    (hp : ∀ p : Nat × Int, p ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList → f.get u p.1 = h.get u p.1) :
    flow_out g f u = flow_out g h u := by
  simp only [flow_out, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  exact foldl_congr (fun p : Nat × Int => f.get u p.1) (fun p : Nat × Int => h.get u p.1) _ 0 hp

theorem flow_in_congr (g : CapacityGraph) (f h : FlowMap) (u : Nat)
    (hv : ∀ v, v < g.size → f.get v u = h.get v u) :
    flow_in g f u = flow_in g h u := by
  simp only [flow_in]
  exact foldl_congr (fun v => f.get v u) (fun v => h.get v u) _ 0
    (fun v hvm => hv v (List.mem_range.mp hvm))

/-! ### Tier 2 — candidate flows -/

theorem toFlow_nonneg (n : Nat) (c : Cand n) (u v : Nat) : 0 ≤ (toFlow n c).get u v := by
  simp only [FlowMap.get, toFlow]
  by_cases hu : u < n
  · by_cases hv : v < n
    · rw [dif_pos hu, dif_pos hv]; exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le _
    · rw [dif_pos hu, dif_neg hv]
  · rw [dif_neg hu]

theorem toFlow_out_of_range (n : Nat) (c : Cand n) (u v : Nat) (h : ¬ u < n ∨ ¬ v < n) :
    (toFlow n c).get u v = 0 := by
  simp only [FlowMap.get, toFlow]
  rcases h with h | h
  · rw [dif_neg h]
  · by_cases hu : u < n
    · rw [dif_pos hu, dif_neg h]
    · rw [dif_neg hu]

/-- Soundness: a candidate accepted by `validB` really is a feasible flow. -/
theorem validB_sound (g : CapacityGraph) (c : Cand g.size) (s t : Nat)
    (hv : validB g (toFlow g.size c) s t = true) :
    is_valid_flow g (toFlow g.size c) s t := by
  simp only [validB, Bool.and_eq_true] at hv
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hv
  rw [List.all_eq_true] at h1 h2
  constructor
  · intro u v
    refine ⟨?_, toFlow_nonneg _ _ _ _⟩
    intro hpos
    have hu : u < g.size := by
      by_contra h
      rw [toFlow_out_of_range g.size c u v (Or.inl h)] at hpos
      exact absurd hpos (lt_irrefl 0)
    have hvn : v < g.size := by
      by_contra h
      rw [toFlow_out_of_range g.size c u v (Or.inr h)] at hpos
      exact absurd hpos (lt_irrefl 0)
    have hc := h1 u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
    rw [List.all_eq_true] at hc
    have hc2 := hc v (List.mem_range.mpr hvn)
    simp only [capOK, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.any_eq_true,
      Bool.and_eq_true] at hc2
    rcases hc2 with hle | ⟨p, hpm, hp1, hp2⟩
    · exact absurd hpos (not_lt.mpr hle)
    · exact ⟨p.2, ⟨hu, p, by simpa using hpm, hp1, rfl⟩, hp2⟩
  · intro u hu hus hut
    have hc := h2 u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    rcases hc with (h | h) | h
    · exact absurd h hus
    · exact absurd h hut
    · exact h

/-- Completeness: every feasible flow is represented by an accepted candidate
with the same value. -/
theorem exists_cand (g : CapacityGraph) (f : FlowMap) (s t : Nat)
    (hwf : g.well_formed) (hb : g.capacities_bounded)
    (hvalid : is_valid_flow g f s t) (hs : s < g.size) :
    ∃ c : Cand g.size, validB g (toFlow g.size c) s t = true ∧
      flow_val g (toFlow g.size c) s = flow_val g f s := by
  have hbound : ∀ i j : Nat, (f.get i j).toNat < 100001 := by
    intro i j
    obtain ⟨hcap, hnn⟩ := hvalid.1 i j
    have hnn' : (0 : Int) ≤ f.get i j := hnn
    rcases hnn'.lt_or_eq with hp | he
    · obtain ⟨cc, hhc, hle⟩ := hcap hp
      have hcc := (hb.2 i j cc hhc).2
      omega
    · omega
  obtain ⟨c, hpt⟩ : ∃ c : Cand g.size, ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
      (toFlow g.size c).get u v = f.get u v := by
    refine ⟨fun i j => ⟨(f.get i.val j.val).toNat, hbound i.val j.val⟩, ?_⟩
    intro u v hu hv
    have hnn : (0 : Int) ≤ f u v := (hvalid.1 u v).2
    simp only [FlowMap.get, toFlow]
    rw [dif_pos hu, dif_pos hv]
    show ((f u v).toNat : Int) = f u v
    omega
  have hout : ∀ u, u < g.size → flow_out g (toFlow g.size c) u = flow_out g f u := by
    intro u hu
    exact flow_out_congr g _ f u
      (fun p hp => hpt u p.1 hu ((hwf u hu).1 p (by simpa using hp)))
  have hin : ∀ u, u < g.size → flow_in g (toFlow g.size c) u = flow_in g f u := by
    intro u hu
    exact flow_in_congr g _ f u (fun v hv => hpt v u hv hu)
  refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [validB, Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, capOK, Bool.or_eq_true,
      decide_eq_true_eq, List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨fun u hu v hv => ?_, fun u hu => ?_⟩
    · rw [hpt u v hu hv]
      by_cases hle : f.get u v ≤ 0
      · exact Or.inl hle
      · push_neg at hle
        obtain ⟨cc, ⟨_, p, hpm, hp1, hp2⟩, hcle⟩ := (hvalid.1 u v).1 hle
        exact Or.inr ⟨p, by simpa using hpm, hp1, by rw [hp2]; exact hcle⟩
    · by_cases hus : u = s
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hus)
      · by_cases hut : u = t
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hut)
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          rw [hin u hu, hout u hu]
          exact hvalid.2 u hu hus hut
  · simp only [flow_val, hin s hs, hout s hs]

/-! ### Tier 3 — `best` is the maximum -/

theorem le_best (g : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hb : g.capacities_bounded) (hs : s < g.size) (other : FlowMap)
    (ho : is_valid_flow g other s t) : flow_val g other s ≤ best g s t := by
  obtain ⟨c, hcv, hceq⟩ := exists_cand g other s t hwf hb ho hs
  rw [← hceq]
  apply Finset.le_max'
  simp only [valSet]
  exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
    (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hcv⟩))

theorem best_achieved (g : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hb : g.capacities_bounded) (hs : s < g.size) :
    ∃ f, is_valid_flow g f s t ∧ flow_val g f s = best g s t := by
  have hmem : best g s t ∈ valSet g s t := Finset.max'_mem _ _
  simp only [valSet] at hmem
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hmem with h | h
  · obtain ⟨c0, hc0v, hc0eq⟩ :=
      exists_cand g (fun _ _ => (0 : Int)) s t hwf hb (zero_flow_valid g s t) hs
    exact ⟨toFlow g.size c0, validB_sound g c0 s t hc0v, by
      rw [hc0eq, zero_flow_val, h]⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hceq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact ⟨toFlow g.size c, validB_sound g c s t (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).2, hceq⟩

end EK
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem max_flow_value_postcond_satisfied (graph : CapacityGraph) (s t : Nat)
    (h_precond : max_flow_value_precond graph s t) :
    max_flow_value_postcond graph s t (max_flow_value graph s t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hb, hs, ht, hst⟩ := h_precond
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfv⟩ := EK.best_achieved graph s t hwf hb hs
  refine ⟨f, ⟨hf, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro other hother
    rw [hfv]
    exact EK.le_best graph s t hwf hb hs other hother
  · rw [hfv]
    rfl
  -- !benchmark @end proof
